messages:
maria: FYI - paging loop last night from 02:12-02:58. We did live mitigation (scaled dedicated pool + fallback to smaller model) and customer impact was limited to a ~5% error spike for one customer segment. I want to build a focused Grafana dashboard for the postmortem and alert tuning discussion. Thoughts?
incident-bot: Incident 2026-05-03-3317001234 created by maria. Pages: paged oncall-alex, paged oncall-jess. Summary saved to incidents/3317001234.
aleks: +1 on a single dashboard. Minimal panels: traffic by region, model variant error rate, per-tenant 5xx%, request latency p50/p95, GPU queue depth, and token throughput. Also a panel for failover events (when requests were rerouted).
maria: Agree. Also need a customer-impact panel: requests from tenant X, error rate, and SLA breach marker. We should have a drilldown from aggregated error rate -> tenant list -> request examples.
jess: I can build the dashboard this afternoon. Will make it templated for region and model. Which golden signals should be top-left? error rate or latency?
samir: Put error rate top-left, latency next, then throughput. Alert noise came from a noisy 5xx alert that fired during the scale-up. We should include the alert history panel so we can correlate alert floods with autoscaler events.
aleks: Also add KV cache hit ratio and prefix cache eviction rate. Those helped explain the tail latency in the runbook. Small panels, 1-row each.
jess: Can you paste the queries you want? I can copy them into panel JSON. Small examples appreciated.
maria: Sure. For tenant error rate (PromQL):
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api",status=~"5..",tenant="TENANT_X"}[5m]))
/ sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api",tenant="TENANT_X"}[5m]))
```
For GPU queue depth (Loki or metrics):
```
avg_over_time(gpu_queue_depth{pool="dedicated"}[5m])
```
For failover events (logs):
```
{app="router"} |= "fallback to model-quantized-v2" | json | count_over_time({app="router"}[1m])
```
jess: Nice, thanks. I'll template TENANT and region. I'll add an annotations row to show autoscaler actions from the autoscaler API metric and the timeline of the mitigation steps.
samir: Re thresholds: current 5xx alert is `>= 0.5% sustained over 5m` and it was too sensitive for small tenants. Proposal: change to `>=1% over 5m` OR require absolute count `>= 50 errors`. That should reduce noise.
aleks: +1 to requiring absolute count. Small tenants generate noisy percents. Also add a mute window in the alert for brief autoscaler rollouts (2m) to avoid duplicates.
maria: Action items: 1) jess build dashboard and commit as infra/grafana/dashboards/incident-3317001234.json; 2) samir open PR to change 5xx alert thresholds & add absolute-count condition; 3) aleks add KV cache panels and failover log panel; 4) I'll draft the post-incident note with customer impact and attach dashboard.
jess: I'll create the dashboard, include drilldowns (click to tenant dashboard) and add panel links. PR by EOD and ping for review. @samir pls confirm threshold semantics so I can include in dashboard notes. :thumbsup:
samir: Confirmed. I'll open the alert PR now and tag you. Expect review request in ~1h.
incident-bot: Incident 3317001234 status -> annotated (dashboard in-progress).
maria: Thanks team. Please add any other panels you think will help the retro. We want the chart set to be small and scannable for the postmortem meeting.
jess: Will do. I'll post the PR link here when ready.
